items.title: Lawrence Cotton Interview, 1996-12-10
items.q: We had some dates we had to perform and Jose said, we need, Cotton, what are we going to do?

ctx.x: Yeah, tell me that one because I think I heard that one. I heard a version of that one. You heard a version of that one?

A version of that one. I'll hear your version. Okay, well, I don't know what happened but he was drunk or probably was high or something. He ran into a bulldozer. Right in the square where La Salle runs into the ferret. Ferret runs to La Salle wherever that point is down there. There's a bulldozer sitting up there and Slim, he ran into it with his car. And he had to end up going to Charity Hospital. We had some dates we had to perform and Jose said, we need, Cotton, what are we going to do? Slim got to go play in…
Yeah, but I want to hear your version.
